## Numbered actions

1. Read TRIPOD_CAMERA_INSTALLATION.md and config/tripod_camera_installation_intake_v1.json. Run `python scripts/validate_tripod_camera_intake.py`; stop on any source-hash or authority failure.
2. Photograph the delivered tripod label, B0477 label, revision or lot markings, and every included head or adapter. Record their identities and photo IDs in received_hardware.
3. Measure the camera-side thread nominal, pitch, usable blind depth, selected screw length, and non-bottoming engagement. Record the positive anti-rotation and independent tether methods before installation.
4. Measure minimum and maximum loaded optical height, selected installed optical height, floor footprint polygon, column/head/camera envelope, adapter envelope, and USB cable service-loop envelope.
5. Place the tripod independently of the robot and board. Keep every leg, column, head, camera, adapter, cable, operator keepout, and ballast envelope outside approved robot swept volumes.
6. Aim the optical axis nominally downward at the board center and record board-intersection XY plus roll, pitch, yaw, and measurement method. Apply witness marks to every leg, column, neck, head, adapter, camera, focus, and cable adjustment.
7. Measure static sag, settle time, cable-pull displacement, remove/reinstall repeatability, 24-hour drift, and vibration response. Record raw evidence references; a photograph of calipers is supporting evidence and does not replace the numeric field.
8. Commission the exact B0477 identity, full-native runtime mode, orientation, focus, aperture, exposure, gain, and white balance using the active software camera profile. Lock the settings and retain hashes and capture evidence.
9. Calibrate intrinsics with the repository-authoritative B0477 ChArUco workflow and retain accepted and rejected views, residuals, previews, and the calibration hash.
10. Capture the complete overview acceptance set. Require all six fiducials and every complete model crop footprint to remain inside the frame at the qualified installed pose.
11. Run conservative collision screening for tripod legs, column, head, camera, adapter, cable, operator keepout, and floor footprint. Then inject support shift, camera tilt, cable pull, tag loss, stale frame, and witness mismatch; every consequential fault must block descent.
12. Set intake qualification results only from retained evidence. Keep authority fields false; completion of this record does not authorize robot power, motion, or contact.

## STOP

> Stop before installation if the received tripod, B0477, adapter, thread, or support geometry is unidentified. Stop before robot power or motion while any intake measurement is missing, any authority field is false, any collision screen is incomplete, or any consequential fault fails to block descent.
